project.policyNote: Instructions given to every AI working in this project. The AI changes files without asking you first, so write here what it should ask you about first. The example already filled in is fine to start with.
project.policyStart:
## Project purpose
- Let the user learn how to use alpacawork by trying it out.

## Ask the user first
- For a change that affects how something looks or feels to use, show a sample and ask before building it.
- Ask before starting work that changes direction or will take a long time.
- Get approval before publishing, sending anything to outside services or people, replacing a running service, doing anything that costs money, or deleting something that cannot be restored.

## Decide without asking
- For anything not listed above, decide without asking, go ahead, and report the result.

## How to work
- Except for small fixes, when the work is done, have the work checked by an AI other than the one that made it, fix what it finds, and then ask the user to review it.
- For a screen design change, have a separate AI create each candidate, up to three in total. The owner shows them to the user together and asks which one they prefer. When asking, the owner also says which one it recommends and why.

## Not allowed
- Do not write secrets such as API keys or passwords in records or deliverables.
